chapter.verse: Note in Pasian’ hehpihna thupha na ngah uh a mawkna na suaksak kei un ci-in kote in Topa tawh nasem khawm mi ka hih ciangun note hong hansuahin kong zol uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh: “A kilawm hun ciangin nangma kam ka ngai hi, gupna ni ciangin nang kong huh hi,” Pasian in a cih mah bangin tu laitak in a kilawm hun ahi hi, tu laitak in gupna ni hun ahi hi.
Ka nasepna uhah mawhsakna a om loh nadingin kipuk nading sukkhakna khat beek ka hih kei uh hi.
Bawlsiat thuakna, zawn’khal thuakna, a kipelh zo lo gimna thuakna,
satna tupna thuakna, thong sung khumna, mi tawh kitotna, nasepna, ihmu lo a, ngakna, gilkial thuakna,
lungsim siangthona, pilna, lungduaina, hehpihna bawlna, Kha Siangtho ngahna, it kheem lo it takpina,
thuman thuhilhna, Pasian’ vangliatna lahna, dikna galhiam ziat lam leh vei lamah silhna hang ahi zongin,
minthan’na leh simmawhna ahi zongin, phatna leh kosiatna thuakin ahi zongin, mikheemte bang ahi zongin, thuman gen mi hi-in,
kuama theih loh mi bangin ahi zongin minthan’na a ngahte hi-in, sihna a thuak mite bangin ahi zongin a hing mite hi-in, thahna a thuak mi bang ahi zongin thahna tawh kipelh mite hi-in,

a dahte bang ahi zongin a nuam tawntung mi hi-in, a zawng mite bang ahi zongin a ngah a hau mite hi-in, sum khat beek a nei lo mi bang ahi zongin na khempeuh a nei mite hi-in Pasian’ nasemte ka hi takpi uh a, na khempeuh tawh kilangin ka lak uh hi.
Korin mite aw, kote kam un note kiangah hon’sa-in a om hi. Ka lungsim uh zong a zai hi.
Kote-ah note in a kawcik na hi kei uh hi: ki-itna hehpihna-ah na kawcik uh hi.
Kote’ thupha nong thukkik nadingun lungsim a zai nei un. Tua bang ka cih ciangin ka tate ka hilh bangin kong ci hi.

A thu-um lote tawh kipawlin kithutuak lo hakkol na puakhawm kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, dikna thu in gitlohna tawh bang ci-a kigawm thei ding hiam? Khuavak in khuamial tawh bang ci kizom thei ding hiam?
Khazih in Belial tawh bang ci kilem theih ding hiam? Thu-umte leh thu-umlote in bangci ngah khawm thei ding hiam?

Pasian’ biakinnpi in milimte tawh bangci kizom thei ding hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh, eite in a nungta Pasian’ biakinnpi i hi hi. Pasian’ thupiakna in: “Amaute sungah ka teeng ding a, amau sungah ka vak kawikawi ding hi; Amau Pasian ka hi ding a, amaute in zong keima mi ahi ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin: “Tua mite lak pan paikhia un la, a tuamin om un. A siangtho lote na lawng kei un.
Note’ Pasian ka hi ding hi, Note zong ka tanu ka tapa na hi ding uh hi,” Vanglian Topa in a ci hi.
